description: Search live, public Givore giveaway listings in one Spanish city, optionally narrowed to one category. Newest first.

category.description: Optional. A published listing-category slug to narrow the search to; omit it to search every listing in the city.

city.description: One city, by slug or name, e.g. "valencia" or "Málaga". Must be a city listed at https://app.givore.com/cities.

name: search_listings
title: Search Listings Tool
